exercises.why: **боец** — боец: warrior; fighter, soldier. Wiktionary: бой + -ец.

exercises.q: He hammered nails into the plank.
exercises.why: **вбил** — вби́ть (perfective): to drive in, to hammer in (also figuratively). Wiktionary: в- + бить.
